ingestionTime.description: Timestamp when the mission planning report was ingested by the collector

reportName.description: Name of the source report file the record was extracted from

reportFolder.description: Folder or interface path from which the source report was collected

satellite_id.description: Satellite identifier extracted from the SatelliteID column

mission.description: Mission identifier set by the collector (S1 or S2 depending on the source report)

datatake_id.description: Datatake identifier from DatatakeId(dec) (S1) or ID/AcquisitionID (S2)

effective_downlink_start.description: Effective downlink start time from the EffectiveDownlinkStart column

effective_downlink_stop.description: Effective downlink stop time from the EffectiveDownlinkStop column

downlink_duration.description: Downlink duration in milliseconds from the DownlinkDuration [msec] column

latency.description: Latency in minutes from the Latency [min] column

station.description: Ground station acquiring the downlink, from the CGS (S1) or Station (S2) column

downlink_polarization.description: Downlink polarization from the DownlinkPolarization column

downlink_absolute_orbit.description: Absolute orbit of the downlink from the DownlinkAbsoluteOrbit (S1) or DownlinkOrbit (S2) column

relative_orbit.description: Relative orbit number from the RelativeOrbit column

absolute_orbit.description: Absolute orbit number from the AbsoluteOrbit column

channel.description: Downlink channel from the Channel column

partial.description: Partial acquisition indicator from the Partial column

interface_name.description: Collector interface name set to S1MissionPlanningALL or S2MissionPlanningALL

acquisition_start.description: Acquisition start time from the SensingTimeStart (S1) or AcquisitionStart (S2) column

acquisition_stop.description: Acquisition stop time from the AcquisitionStop column

acquisition_duration.description: Acquisition duration in milliseconds from the SensingDuration [msec] (S1) or AcquisitionDuration [msec] (S2) column

number_of_scenes.description: Number of scenes from the Scenes column

timeliness.description: Timeliness category from the Timeliness column

status.description: Acquisition or downlink status from the Status column

polarization.description: Acquisition polarization from the Polarization column

instrument_mode.description: Instrument acquisition mode from the InstrumentMode column

session_id.description: Downlink session identifier from the DLSession column, split on hyphen or whitespace

downlink_execution_time.description: Downlink execution time from the DownlinkExecutionTime column
